verdict.rationale: The Cactus repo says its engine exposes OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision, and that `cactus run` launches models locally. Nothing shows these APIs are served over a local HTTP server endpoint rather than through in-process bindings. missing for 10: documented command or option to start a local HTTP server, endpoint/port documentation, confirmation that any loaded or converted model can be served, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Cactus Engine ←── OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech, and vision.
Step 1: brew install cactus-compute/cactus/cactus - Step 2: cactus run
Any HuggingFace model can be converted using cactus convert [HF-Name], though experimental.
